services.name: Balloon & Bike
services.desc: If you live in San Francisco, the East Bay, Marin, or anywhere in the Bay Area, that dream of a sunrise balloon ride over wine country doesn’t have to mean a long, stressful trek to Napa. Sonoma Ballooning has quietly become the go-to adventure for locals and savvy travelers who want that bucket-list aerial view-without the traffic jams and packed schedules that so often steal the joy from sunrise activities. Below, we’ll share exactly why Sonoma Ballooning is the Bay Area’s easiest and most rewarding sunrise adventure, and how you can make the absolute most of your morning from start to finish. services.name: sunrise vs. sunset balloon rides
services.desc: Few experiences can compare to the wonder of floating above rolling vineyards, golden hills, and shimmering ponds in a hot air balloon over Sonoma wine country. But when planning this adventure, many people ask us: Is sunrise really better than sunset for a balloon ride in Sonoma? As the closest large-scale balloon operator to San Francisco, and the only family-owned company in the area, we get this question a lot. Here’s our in-depth, honest guide to both options based on both science and hundreds of guest experiences. blurb: Guests check in at dawn at Sonoma Skypark for a briefing, watch the balloon inflate, then fly 45–60 minutes over vineyards with views of Sonoma and Napa valleys. Flights include a traditional champagne toast on landing. The company offers shared sunrise flights, private VIP flights, and group events.
